description: Create a video room and get joinUrl for guests. No start step: it goes LIVE by itself when the first person is in it through joinUrl (INSTANT, the default, starts LIVE). At joinUrl only DCAST accounts get in, via a waiting room the host admits from. Seats and recording follow the account plan; planAdjustments in the answer lists anything reduced. scheduled_start / scheduled_end are planned times (ISO 8601, end after start). allow_participant_video / allow_participant_audio false make a room where guests watch but do not publish.

scheduled_end.description: Planned end, ISO 8601, after the start

name: create_room
title: Create a video room
